metadata.title: Bank Accounts Ledger
metadata.description: Company bank account balances and movements

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.bankNote: What the bank statements should show
dashboard.outstandingNote: {count, plural, =0 {No cheques waiting to clear} one {# cheque not yet cleared} other {# cheques not yet cleared}}
dashboard.promisedBar: {outstanding} of the {bank} bank balance is promised to cheques not yet cleared
dashboard.overCommitted: Outstanding cheques exceed the bank balance.
dashboard.dueSoonCount: {count, plural, one {# due within 7 days} other {# due within 7 days}}
dashboard.overdue: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

movement.saved: Saved. You can enter the next movement.

ledger.voidPairNote: Both halves of the internal transfer will be voided.
ledger.filteredCount: {count, plural, =0 {No matching movements} one {# matching movement} other {# matching movements}}. Each row's balance is the true balance on that date.

cheque.title: Cheques
cheque.saved: Cheque saved. You can enter the next one.
cheque.count: {count, plural, =0 {No cheques} one {# cheque} other {# cheques}}
cheque.undoClearNote: The cheque goes back to the outstanding list.

login.title: Sign in
login.noAccess: This login has no access to the app. Contact your admin.

settings.name: Name
settings.firstPasswordNote: Share the first password with the user securely. At least 8 characters.
settings.userCreated: User added. They can sign in now.
settings.auditNote: The last {count} changes to financial data.

accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.openingNote: Take the opening balance from the bank statement on this date. It may be zero or negative. Movements before this date are rejected.
accounts.archiveNote: The history stays, but the account leaves the entry forms and the dashboard.

inbox.title: AI Inbox
inbox.description: Messages and cheque photos read by AI. Check each one, correct it if needed, then approve or reject. Nothing counts in a balance until it is approved.
inbox.photoUnavailable: The photo could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
inbox.photoDeleted: The photo was deleted when the entry was rejected.
inbox.duplicateWarning: A transfer with the same account, amount, date and reference already exists. Check the details, then press Approve again to save it anyway.
inbox.rejectNote: Nothing is saved to the ledger. A photo is deleted.

warnings.directionMissing: Not clear whether money came in or went out.
warnings.amountInvalid: The amount “{value}” is not a valid positive amount.
warnings.accountUnresolved: Not clear which of our accounts this is. Choose one.
warnings.accountNoTransfers: This account does not receive transfers.
warnings.accountNoCheques: This account does not issue cheques.
warnings.counterpartyMissing: No sender, beneficiary or payee found.
warnings.counterpartyNew: “{value}” is a new name. Check the spelling, or keep it to add a new name.
warnings.dateMissing: No date found: today’s date is filled in.
warnings.dateInvalid: The date “{value}” is not a real date.
warnings.dateInFuture: The date {value} is in the future.
warnings.dateFarFuture: The date {value} is more than a year ahead.
warnings.dateFarPast: The date {value} is more than 6 months ago.
warnings.amountWordsMissing: Could not read the amount in words to double-check the digits.
warnings.amountWordsMismatch: The amount in words (“{value}”) does not match the digits.

input.title: New entry
input.label: Describe the transfer or cheque, or add a cheque photo
input.placeholder: e.g. استلمنا تحويل 15 ألف من شركة النور على حساب CIB امبارح
input.sent: Added below. Check it, then approve or reject.

errors.emptyInput: Type a message or add a photo.
errors.textTooLong: The message is too long: 2,000 characters at most.
errors.imageTooLarge: The photo is too large even after shrinking. Try another photo.
errors.imageUnsupported: This file can't be read as a photo. Use a JPEG or PNG photo.
errors.aiUnavailable: The AI service didn't respond. Nothing was saved and your message is still here: please try again in a minute.
errors.aiUnreadable: The AI couldn't read this. Write it more clearly, or take a sharper photo, and try again.
errors.aiFailed: The AI service is not set up correctly, so trying again won't help. Please tell an admin.
errors.uploadFailed: The photo couldn't be saved. Nothing was saved: please try again.
